title: Language of the Client Connector app, its notifications and the AUP

prose.label: Templates and the AUP.
prose.text: {{template-no-locale}} Whether the AUP can be localized is open: [[zcc.acceptable-use:localization]]. Which language is used when the system language is not supported is open {{gap:fallback-language}}.

checks.do: Whether the user's system language is one Client Connector supports at the installed version.
Whether the app profile forces English or the user changed the language in the More window.

system-language.statement: Client Connector can switch its user interface language to match the system language.

quotes: Zscaler Client Connector supports changing the language of the app user interface based on the system language.

languages.statement: French is supported from 4.5 on Windows and 4.3 on macOS, and German from 5.0 on Windows; the vendor lists Chinese (Taiwan), Japanese and Spanish, and German on macOS, as not currently supported.

quotes: | Zscaler Client Connector for Windows | Chinese Taiwan Traditional (zh-TW) | Not currently supported | | French (fr-FR) | Version 4.5 | | | German (de-DE) | Version 5.0 |
| Zscaler Client Connector for macOS | Chinese Taiwan Traditional (zh-TW) | Not currently supported | | French (fr-FR) | Version 4.3 |
Chinese Taiwan Traditional (zh-TW) | Not currently supported

display-language-setting.statement: On Windows 4.8 and later, an app profile sets the default display language for the app and the Notifications window text: Use System Language (the default) or English. Users can change it in the More window.

quotes: Select the default display language for the Zscaler Client Connector app and the text in the Notifications window:
Use System Language: The app displays based on the system language. This value is the default setting.
Users can change the display language from the default on the More window in the app
English: The app displays in English, regardless of the user's system language settings.
This feature is available only with Zscaler Client Connector version 4.8 and later for Windows.
evidence.after: Users can change the display language from the default on the More window in the app

zia-eun-languages.statement: ZIA notifications delivered through Client Connector can be customized in multiple supported languages.

quotes: You can customize notification messages in multiple, supported languages

template-no-locale.statement: The notification template model has no language or locale field.
template-no-locale.conditions: Rests on absence: the Go SDK's NotificationTemplate struct at the pin has no language field, and the template article lists none.

fallback-language.title: Language used when the system language is unsupported
fallback-language.detail: Which language the app and its notifications use when Use System Language is set and the system language is not in the supported list, and how templates relate to language.
